use std::ptr;


pub struct fastdata;
impl fastdata {

    const KEYS: [f64; 2] = [
        f64::MIN, f64::MAX
    ];

    #[must_use]
    pub fn key_slice() -> &'static [f64] { &Self::KEYS }

    #[must_use]
    pub fn keys() -> impl Iterator<Item = f64> {
        Self::KEYS.iter().copied()
    }

    #[must_use]
    pub fn contains(key: f64) -> bool {

        let mut lo: i32 = 0;
        let mut hi: i32 = 1;
        while lo <= hi && key >= Self::KEYS[lo as usize] && key <= Self::KEYS[hi as usize] {
            let lo_key: f64 = Self::KEYS[lo as usize];
            let hi_key: f64 = Self::KEYS[hi as usize];

            if lo_key == hi_key {
                if lo_key == key {
                    return true;
                }

                break;
            }

            let lo_value = lo_key as f64;
            let hi_value = hi_key as f64;
            let mut mid: i32 = if lo_value == hi_value {
                lo + ((hi - lo) >> 1)
            } else {
                lo + ((((key as f64) - lo_value) * ((hi - lo) as f64)) / (hi_value - lo_value)) as i32
            };

            if mid < lo {
                mid = lo;
            } else if mid > hi {
                mid = hi;
            }

            let mid_key: f64 = Self::KEYS[mid as usize];
            if mid_key == key {
                return true;
            }
            if mid_key < key {
                lo = mid + 1;
            } else {
                hi = mid - 1;
            }
        }

        false
    }

    pub const ITEM_COUNT: usize = 2;
    pub const MIN_KEY: f64 = f64::MIN;
    pub const MAX_KEY: f64 = f64::MAX;
